claims.summary: For a translated unit interval active law partitioned into interval pieces of lengths ell_j, after pushforward v->2zv the exact unnormalized critical Fourier coefficient of every nonempty piece is 1/|z|, the normalized constant is 1/(|z| ell_j), and the account03/B14 r35 square-root budget is |z|^{-1/2} sum_j sqrt(ell_j). Equal N-cell refinement costs exactly sqrt(N) before pair optimization.

For Q=2X1X2+2ZV with Z uniform [1,2], V uniform [0,1], the matrix spectrum is {1,-1,1,-1}; the probability law is unchanged by partitioning V. Whole r35 effective parameter is 12-8sqrt(2), while N equal normalized active pieces force parameter (12-8sqrt(2))N and the optimized F-envelope diverges. Claude Theorem A still gives ||p_Q||_infinity <= 6 kappa_3^(1/3), so only the fragment-first proof interface fails.
